author: Owoicho Ajayi (Founder & Lead Director)

content_html:
Over the past five days, Shape Your Mind Consult successfully concluded a five-day Group Problem Management Plus (Group PM+) Training of Trainers for the dedicated staff of #PUI, co-facilitated with Dr. Ruquayyah.

Over five engaging sessions, participants strengthened their understanding of the Group PM+ model, facilitation skills, stress management techniques, problem-solving, behavioral activation, social support, supervion, and effective implementation strategies.

Through practical exercises, role plays, and peer learning, participants built the confidence to deliver quality, context specific evidence-based psychosocial interventions within their communities of intervention.

Grateful to all participants for their commitment, active engagement, and passion for expanding access to quality and, scalable mental health and psychosocial support services.

title: Strengthening Frontline Humanitarian Response Through PM+ Training of Trainers in Maiduguri
author: Owoicho Ajayi (Founder & Lead Director)
excerpt: In the month of march, Shape Your Mind facilitated a transformative five-day PM+ (Problem Management Plus) Training of Trainers (ToT) for a multidisciplinary team at #PremièreUrgenceInternationale in Maiduguri. This intensive refresher...
content_html:
In the month of march, Shape Your Mind facilitated a transformative five-day PM+ (Problem Management Plus) Training of Trainers (ToT) for a multidisciplinary team at #PremièreUrgenceInternationale in Maiduguri.

This intensive refresher brought together Doctors, Nurses, Psychologists, case managers, HRs, projects Managers and Community Health Extension Workers (CHEWS) to bridge the gap between protection, health, and nutrition response.

The five-day session focused on sharpening clinical precision, building confidence, updating protocol, knowledge exchange and intervention clarity, ensuring that evidence-based psychological support is seamlessly integrated into frontline humanitarian aid.

By strengthening the pedagogical and technical skills of these master trainers, Shape Your Mind have directly enhanced participants capacity to deliver high-quality, scalable mental health interventions.

This refresher training empowered participants to mentor others, ensuring that life-saving psychosocial support remains at the heart of integrated healthcare delivery in complex humanitarian response.

title: Optimizing Performance: A Holistic Approach to Success in the Workplace
author: Owoicho Ajayi (Clinical Director)
excerpt: Introduction Achieving peak performance in the workplace involves more than just meeting deadlines and delivering results. It requires a holistic approach that encompasses physical and mental well-being, effective communication, and...
content_html:
Introduction

Achieving peak performance in the workplace involves more than just meeting deadlines and delivering results. It requires a holistic approach that encompasses physical and mental well-being, effective communication, and continuous personal development. In this article, we’ll delve into key factors influencing workplace performance and explore strategies for cultivating success in a professional setting.

Understanding the Dynamics of Workplace Performance

  • Balancing Workload: Striking the right balance between workload and available resources is crucial. Overburdening employees can lead to burnout, negatively impacting both productivity and job satisfaction.
  • Effective Communication: Clear communication is the cornerstone of successful collaboration in any workplace. Miscommunication or lack of communication can result in misunderstandings, errors, and a decline in overall team performance.
  • Professional Development: Encouraging and investing in continuous learning and development fosters a culture of growth within the organization. Employees who feel supported in their professional growth are more likely to be engaged and perform at their best.

Strategies for Enhancing Workplace Performance

  • Wellness Programs: Implementing wellness programs that address physical and mental health can have a positive impact on employee performance. Initiatives such as fitness classes, mindfulness sessions, and mental health resources contribute to a healthier and more engaged workforce.
  • Goal Setting and Feedback: Clearly defined goals and regular feedback sessions are essential for performance improvement. Employees thrive when they understand expectations and receive constructive feedback to enhance their skills and capabilities.
  • Collaborative Work Environment: Fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment promotes creativity and innovation. When employees feel valued and heard, they are more likely to contribute their best efforts to team projects.
  • Flexibility and Work-Life Balance: Recognizing the importance of work-life balance and providing flexible work arrangements can lead to increased job satisfaction and performance. Employees who feel supported in their personal lives are more likely to bring their best selves to work.
  • Recognition and Rewards: Acknowledging and rewarding employee achievements boosts morale and motivation. Recognition programs, whether through public acknowledgment or tangible rewards, contribute to a positive workplace culture.

Conclusion

Achieving optimal performance in the workplace goes beyond the completion of tasks; it involves creating an environment that nurtures the well-being and professional development of employees. By addressing workload, promoting effective communication, and implementing strategies for personal and professional growth, organizations can cultivate a culture of success where employees are motivated, engaged, and empowered to perform at their best. Remember, a thriving workforce is not only a key driver of organizational success but also a testament to a workplace that values the holistic well-being of its employees.

content_html:
Mental Health Awareness Month

Home / Blog / MH Awareness Month

Mental Health Awareness Month

  • SHAPE UR MIND
  • May 01, 2024
  • 0 Comment

At shape Your Mind, we acknowledged the importance of metal health. To this end, we join the rest of the world to create awareness with key messages that will promote, give access, and reduce mental health stigma.

The Importance of Mental Health

Mental health is an integral part of our overall health. It influences how we think, feel, and act, affecting our ability to handle stress, relate to others, and make choices. Despite its importance, mental health issues are often misunderstood and stigmatized, leading to significant barriers in seeking help and support. By addressing these issues head-on, we can create a society where mental health is prioritized and valued just as much as physical health.

Raising Awareness

Creating awareness is the first step towards breaking the silence around mental health. At Shape Your Mind, we are dedicated to educating the public about mental health issues, symptoms, and the importance of early intervention. Through workshops, seminars, and online campaigns, we aim to dispel myths and provide accurate information that empowers individuals to seek help and support others in their mental health journeys.

Providing Access to Resources

Access to mental health resources is crucial for those in need. We strive to connect individuals with the support and care they require. Our initiatives include providing information on local mental health services, offering guidance on navigating the healthcare system, and creating safe spaces for open discussions about mental health. By making resources readily available, we hope to bridge the gap between those in need and the support systems that can help them.

Reducing Stigma

Stigma remains one of the most significant obstacles to mental health care. Negative attitudes and misconceptions about mental health conditions often prevent individuals from seeking the help they need. At Shape Your Mind, we are committed to challenging these stereotypes and fostering a culture of understanding and compassion. Our campaigns highlight personal stories of resilience and recovery, demonstrating that mental health issues are common and that seeking help is a sign of strength, not weakness.

At Shape Your Mind, we believe that every step taken towards mental health awareness brings us closer to a healthier, more compassionate society. Let us unite in our efforts to shape a better future for mental health.

Navigating Stress in the Academic Journey: A Guide to Mental Wellness

  • SHAPE UR MIND
  • November 15, 2023
  • 0 Comment

Introduction

Embarking on the academic journey can be an exhilarating experience, filled with opportunities for growth and learning. However, it also comes with its fair share of challenges that can impact mental well-being. In this article, we will explore the common stressors faced by students and researchers, shedding light on practical strategies to maintain mental health throughout the academic pursuit.

Identifying Stressors in Academic Life

  • Academic Pressure: The relentless pursuit of academic excellence often leads to intense pressure. Balancing coursework, research projects, and exams can be overwhelming, contributing to stress and anxiety.
  • Isolation and Burnout: The solitary nature of research and study can result in feelings of isolation. Prolonged periods of intense focus without adequate breaks may lead to burnout, affecting both productivity and mental health.
  • Uncertain Future: The uncertainty about future career paths and academic outcomes can be a significant source of stress for students. The pressure to make the right choices for long-term success can be daunting.

Strategies for Promoting Mental Wellness

  • Time Management: Effective time management is crucial for reducing stress. Creating a realistic schedule that allows for breaks and leisure activities can enhance productivity and prevent burnout.
  • Connectivity and Support: Building a strong support network is essential. Regular interactions with peers, mentors, and friends provide a sense of belonging and shared experiences, reducing feelings of isolation.
  • Mind-Body Connection: Recognizing the connection between physical and mental well-being is vital. Incorporating regular exercise, healthy nutrition, and sufficient sleep into one's routine positively impacts overall mental health.
  • Mindfulness Practices: Mindfulness techniques, such as deep breathing, meditation, and yoga, can help manage stress and promote a sense of calm. These practices foster self-awareness and resilience in the face of challenges.
  • Seeking Professional Help: If stress and anxiety become overwhelming, seeking support from mental health professionals is a proactive step. Universities often provide counseling services that can offer guidance and coping strategies.

Conclusion

While the academic journey may bring its share of stressors, prioritizing mental wellness is essential for long-term success and fulfilment. By identifying and addressing the sources of stress, implementing effective strategies for self-care, and seeking support when needed, individuals can navigate the challenges of academic life with resilience and a positive mindset. Remember, a healthy mind is not only conducive to academic success but also lays the foundation for a well-rounded and satisfying life.

Nurturing Mental Well-being: A Vital Aspect of a Successful Life

  • SHAPE UR MIND
  • November 14, 2023
  • 0 Comment

 

Introduction

In the fast-paced world we live in, where success is often measured by professional achievements and academic accolades, the importance of mental health tends to be overlooked. However, maintaining a sound mental state is fundamental to leading a successful and fulfilling life. This article explores the significance of mental well-being, its impact on academic and personal success, and practical tips for nurturing a healthy mind.

The Connection Between Mental Health and Success:

In the realm of academia and professional pursuits, the relationship between mental health and success is profound. A healthy mind is more resilient, creative, and capable of handling the challenges that come with academic rigor and career responsibilities. Research indicates that individuals with good mental health are better equipped to concentrate, learn, and excel in their chosen fields.

Academic Pressures and Mental Health:

For students engaged in rigorous academic pursuits, the pressures can be overwhelming. Balancing coursework, exams, and research demands can take a toll on mental well-being. It’s crucial to recognize the signs of stress and anxiety early on to prevent them from escalating into more serious mental health issues.

Practical Tips for Maintaining Mental Health:

  • Self-Care Routine: Establishing a consistent self-care routine is essential. This includes adequate sleep, regular exercise, and a balanced diet. These basic practices contribute significantly to overall well-being.
  • Mindfulness and Meditation: Incorporating mindfulness and meditation into daily life can help manage stress and enhance mental clarity. These practices encourage staying present in the moment, reducing anxiety about the future or regrets about the past
  • Seeking Support: It's important to build a support network. This can include friends, family, or mental health professionals. Sharing concerns and seeking advice can provide valuable perspectives and alleviate the burden of academic and personal challenges.
  • Setting Realistic Goals: Establishing realistic and achievable goals is key to preventing burnout. Break down larger tasks into smaller, more manageable steps, and celebrate achievements along the way.
  • Balancing Academics and Hobbies: While academic pursuits are important, it's equally crucial to engage in hobbies and activities that bring joy and relaxation. Whether it's listening to music, pursuing a creative endeavor, or spending time in nature, diversifying interests contributes positively to mental health.

Conclusion:

In the pursuit of academic and personal success, the significance of mental health cannot be overstated. By prioritizing self-care, seeking support, and maintaining a healthy balance between academic and personal life, individuals can foster a resilient and thriving mind. Remember, success is not only about achievements on paper but also about the well-being that allows one to navigate life’s challenges with grace and determination.
